entries.title: Romans 6:1
segments: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

entries.title: Romans 6:2
segments: God forbid. We who died to sin, how shall we any longer live therein?

entries.title: Romans 6:3
segments: Or are ye ignorant that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

entries.title: Romans 6:4
segments: We were buried therefore with him through baptism unto death: that like as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

entries.title: Romans 6:5
segments: For if we have become united with [him] in the likeness of his death, we shall be also [in the likeness] of his resurrection;

entries.title: Romans 6:6
segments: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with [him], that the body of sin might be done away, that so we should no longer be in bondage to sin;

entries.title: Romans 6:7
segments: for he that hath died is justified from sin.

entries.title: Romans 6:8
segments: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him;

entries.title: Romans 6:9
segments: knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death no more hath dominion over him.

entries.title: Romans 6:10
segments: For the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

entries.title: Romans 6:11
segments: Even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Romans 6:12
segments: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey the lusts thereof:

entries.title: Romans 6:13
segments: neither present your members unto sin [as] instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves unto God, as alive from the dead, and your members [as] instruments of righteousness unto God.

entries.title: Romans 6:14
segments: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under law, but under grace.

entries.title: Romans 6:15
segments: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? God forbid.

entries.title: Romans 6:16
segments: Know ye not, that to whom ye present yourselves [as] servants unto obedience, his servants ye are whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

entries.title: Romans 6:17
segments: But thanks be to God, that, whereas ye were servants of sin, ye became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto ye were delivered;

entries.title: Romans 6:18
segments: and being made free from sin, ye became servants of righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 6:19
segments: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye presented your members [as] servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now present your members [as] servants to righteousness unto sanctification.

entries.title: Romans 6:20
segments: For when ye were servants of sin, ye were free in regard of righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 6:21
segments: What fruit then had ye at that time in the things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

entries.title: Romans 6:22
segments: But now being made free from sin and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end eternal life.

entries.title: Romans 6:23
segments: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
